notes: published_not_active: the published KID is NOT the active contract KID. The hosted signer fails closed while they differ, which is intentional — no Okta application trusts the new key yet. Served by a DEDICATED static project on its own hostname, never by the V3 application, so there is exactly one authoritative JWKS URL. Cutover is O2C.2.
hosting: dedicated static Vercel project idcaddie-staging-jwks on the custom hostname jwks.staging.idcaddie.com; no auth, no cookies, no AWS credentials at request time
